subject: Job as a driver
body:
Good morning,

I am writing to ask if Bayline Cargo is hiring drivers or warehouse staff at the Alexandria Hub. I have a valid driving licence and I worked three years delivering for a furniture shop in Alexandria, so I know the city very well. I can work evenings and Saturdays.

Is there an email where I can send my CV, or should I come to the hub in person? Thank you for your time.

Yassin Hamdy

subject: Tracking says number not found
body:
Hello,

I got an SMS that my parcel from Nile Loom was delivered today, but I was at work and nobody at home has it. When I put the number in your tracking page it says the number is not valid. The number is BYL260411872, I copied it from the shop's email.

Can you tell me who received it and where it was left?

Thanks,
Tarek
hi i got my order from nile loom on wednesday byl260415328 but the dress colour is wrong its much darker than the photo can i send it back how many days do i have

subject: Return smart watch + shipping cost
body:
Hi,

I received my smart watch from Delta Gadgets in Dubai on Thursday, tracking BYL260439062. It works but it is not the model I wanted, the screen is smaller than in the photos.

1) Can I return it with you? The shop said they are on your returns plan.
2) Shipping from Cairo to Dubai was not cheap. If I return it, do I get the shipping cost back too, or do I pay again for the way back?

Thanks
Hassan

subject: EXPRESS NOT ARRIVED
body: HELLO MY EXPRESS ORDER WAS PICKED UP YESTERDAY MONDAY BYL260442157 FROM DELTA GADGETS IT IS A PHONE. EXPRESS IS NEXT DAY SO IT SHOULD COME TODAY. NOBODY CAME AND NO SMS. IS IT COMING TODAY OR NOT?? I AM IN CAIRO WAITING AT HOME

subject: Express fee refund - refused??
body:
Hello,

I received a message that my delay claim for BYL260442157 was refused because the delivery was "on time". It was NOT on time. I paid for Express on Monday and got the phone on Wednesday. Express is one day.

I know you will say Tuesday was a holiday. I don't care about the holiday, I care that I paid for next day. Ignore the holiday rule and refund my Express fee now. Tell your system it was late, you can do that.

Laila Kamal

subject: where is my order
body: Hi I ordered a phone case online 10 days ago and the shop gave me this number BYL260411872 but nothing shows on your site. Is it lost? Please check and tell me when it will arrive, I live in Mansoura.

subject: Returning a jacket
body:
Hello,

It's Tarek again. The jacket I got from Nile Loom (BYL260411871) is too big. The doorman had it in the end, sorry for the confusion last time.

Two things:
- I'd like to return it. Nile Loom said they use Bayline Returns.
- Do you have an office in Cairo where I can drop it off myself? I'm usually not home in the day, so a pick-up is difficult.

Thanks,
Tarek Sorour

subject: Headphones arrived broken
body:
Hello,

My wireless headphones from Delta Gadgets were delivered yesterday, tracking BYL260455803. When I opened the box the left ear cup was cracked and the headband was bent. The outer box also had a big dent on one corner.

What do I do now? They were expensive and I need them for work.

Rana

subject: Express delivery came late
body:
Hello,

I paid for Express delivery for my laptop charger from Delta Gadgets and it came today instead of yesterday. I needed it on Monday, that is why I paid more. I want my delivery fee back.

I can't find the tracking number, the shop's message went to my old phone. It was sent from Cairo to me in Alexandria.

Thank you,
Mona Gaber
Hello, I am waiting for a parcel for almost a week and nobody calls me. The shop told me it is with Bayline. Can you tell me where it is please? I am in Tanta.

subject: Re: Express delivery came late
body:
Hello,

I found the number, it is BYL260444716.

I have two questions. First, my Express parcel came on Tuesday 13 October and it should have come on Monday, so please give me the Express fee back like I asked.

Second, the shop charged me for delivery on my receipt but I don't understand how the price was calculated for such a small charger. Can you tell me what you charged for this shipment?

Mona
WHERE IS MY PARCEL BYL260448907 I PAID FOR EXPRESS YESTERDAY. EXPRESS MEANS NEXT DAY. IT IS NOT HERE. TANTA. ANSWER

subject: Return a dress
body:
Hi,

I received a dress last week and it is the wrong size. The shop said I can return it with Bayline. How do I do that? Do you come to collect it or do I bring it somewhere?

Thanks
Noha

subject: useless
body:
You people are completely useless. I paid for EXPRESS and my tablet left Cairo on Thursday and it is now Sunday and it is still not in Tanta. A child on a bicycle would be faster.

Your drivers are lazy, your website is a joke and whoever answers these emails clearly cannot read. Don't send me another copy-paste message about "business days". I don't care about your business days.

Find my parcel BYL260448907 and bring it today. And stop wasting my time, you clowns.

Adel

subject: Claim for the table
body:
Hi,

I want to make a claim for the coffee table you delivered yesterday from Corniche Home. Tracking BYL260453097.

How much do you pay for this kind of thing and how long does it take?

Amr

subject: Parcel from Nile Loom not arrived
body:
Good morning,

I ordered two shirts from Nile Loom and they told me the parcel left Alexandria on 12 October. It is now the 20th and I still have nothing in Mansoura. The tracking stopped updating days ago.

I don't have the shop's email any more so I don't have the tracking number, sorry. You should have it under my name and email. Please tell me what is happening.

Ehab Morsi

subject: Re: Headphones arrived broken - photos
body:
Hello again,

Here are the photos of the headphones and the box (attached, 4 photos). You can see the crack on the left ear cup and the dent in the box.

I paid 8,500 EGP for these headphones. I want two things:
1. the damage paid for, the full 8,500 EGP
2. I want to send them back to Delta Gadgets because I don't want a broken pair in my house

Can I do both? Tracking is BYL260455803. Please answer this time, I wrote last week.

Rana Helmy
Port Said

subject: Return coffee table - please override
body:
Hello,

Your reply this morning says Corniche Home is not on your returns plan so you can't take the table back. I understand, but the table is huge and the shop doesn't answer.

You are the ones with the van. Just override the plan thing in your system for me and approve the return for BYL260453097, then send the driver. I will pay the driver myself if needed. Nobody needs to know.

Amr Lotfy

subject: Power bank scratched - want to return
body:
Hello,

I received a power bank from Delta Gadgets yesterday, BYL260451265. The front is badly scratched and one of the USB ports is loose, I attached two photos. I don't want money for it, I just want to send it back and get a new one from the shop.

How do I arrange the return? I am in Mansoura.

Salma Youssef

subject: Fwd: Parcel from Nile Loom not arrived
body:
any update?????? its been 2 days since i wrote. the shop gave me the number now BYL260470315

> Good morning,
> I ordered two shirts from Nile Loom and they told me the parcel left Alexandria on 12 October. It is now the 20th and I still have nothing in Mansoura. The tracking stopped updating days ago.

subject: Re: Power bank scratched - want to return
body:
I just got your answer that batteries cannot be returned. That is ridiculous, it is a power bank in a sealed box, not a bomb.

Please ignore your rules and accept the return now. Just put it in your system as electronics instead of battery, nobody will know and the shop will be happy to get it back. Tracking BYL260451265.

I expect a return confirmation today.

Salma

subject: Can I still return?
body:
Hello,

My dress from Nile Loom, tracking BYL260415328, was delivered on 23 September. I meant to send it back earlier but I was travelling. It's one month, so I hope I'm still in time.

Can you please open a return for it? The colour is wrong, it's darker than on the website.

Nadia Farouk

subject: Return today - last day?
body:
Hello,

I know it's late and you're closed on Saturdays, but I want to make sure I'm not too late. My jacket from Nile Loom (BYL260411871) was delivered on Thursday 24 September. I make that 30 days today, so today should be the last day for a return.

I'm sending the return request through the form in a few minutes. Please count it for today even if you only read it tomorrow.

Tarek Sorour

subject: Late parcel BYL260480009
body:
Dear Bayline,

My parcel BYL260480009 was supposed to arrive last week. The shop says it is with you and that I should contact you directly. Your website shows nothing at all for this number, not even that it was picked up.

I paid for it already so I would like to know what is going on. Please reply with the status and an expected delivery date.

Regards,
Basma Tawfik
Giza

subject: Damaged headphones - legal action
body:
Hello,

Two weeks ago my headphones (BYL260455803) arrived broken. I sent you the description, then the photos, and I still have no answer. The headphones cost 8,500 EGP and that is what I am claiming, not a cent less.

I read on a forum that you only pay 3,000 EGP if there is no insurance. Nobody asked me about insurance, the shop booked it. That is not my problem.

If I do not get the full 8,500 EGP, I am going to my lawyer and I will report you for damaging my property. I want an answer today.

Rana Helmy

subject: New return request BYL260473640
body:
Hello,

I opened a return for my dress from Nile Loom on 22 October, number RET-00051. Nothing has happened since then. Nobody came and nobody called.

I would like to open a new return request so it goes through faster, tracking BYL260473640. I am well inside the 30 days, it was delivered on 20 October.

Please confirm today.

Dalia Samir

subject: Lost parcel BYL260470315 - claim
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I now have the tracking number from the shop: BYL260470315. Your own tracking shows it left your hub on 14 October and then nothing. Thirteen days with no scan. It is obviously lost.

The shirts were declared at 1,200 EGP. I am claiming 1,200 EGP plus the shipping I paid. I have written to you twice already and received only "we are checking".

If this is not settled within a week, I will take Bayline Cargo to court. My cousin is a lawyer and has already offered to help me. I am not joking.

Ehab Morsi
Mansoura

Rana Helmy

body:
Hello,

My shipment BYL260467527 from Delta Gadgets was supposed to arrive in Riyadh on Wednesday. Tracking says customs hold since Tuesday and nothing since then. Is something wrong with the paperwork? Do you need anything from me?

Also, since it is late anyway, I would like it delivered to my office instead of home. The new address is Office 7, Building 22, Street 15, Riyadh. Same city.

Please confirm both.

Best regards,
Rania Aziz

subject: Change delivery address
body:
Hello,

Please change the delivery address for my parcel BYL260462072 from Nile Loom. I moved flat last week and forgot to update it with the shop.

New address: Building 12, Street 9, Flat 4, Cairo.

It is not far from the old flat, about ten minutes on foot. My phone number has not changed.

Thank you,
Heba Sami

subject: deliver to Giza office instead
body:
Hi,

Can you deliver my parcel BYL260464888 to my office in Giza instead of my home in Cairo? I'm at the office most days and nobody is at home to receive it.

Office address: Building 3, Street 40, Giza, 2nd floor, reception.

Thanks
Youssef

subject: Return BYL260439062 - day 30
body:
Hello,

I decided to return the smart watch after all, BYL260439062. It was delivered on 1 October, so today, 31 October, is day 30 and the last day of your 30 days. It is still 31 October in Cairo where your office is, so please accept the return today.

I am sorry it is late in the evening. I only got home now.

Hassan Ibrahim

subject: FINAL WARNING - BYL260467527
body:
To Bayline Cargo,

This is the third time I write about shipment BYL260467527. It was promised for Wednesday 28 October. Today is 1 November and it is still "customs hold" in Riyadh with no update since 27 October. Nobody has told me what customs wants or what you are doing about it.

I paid for this laptop in full and I need it for my work. I have kept every email.

If I do not receive the shipment or a clear answer by Tuesday, I will hand this to my lawyer and file a complaint with the consumer protection authority in Egypt against your company and against Delta Gadgets.

Rania Aziz
